query:
SELECT 
  f.id,
  f.frage,
  f.pseudonym,
  f.status,
  f.userId,
  u.name AS user_name,
  u.email AS user_email,
  f.createdAt,
  f.beantwortetAt
FROM raum36_fragen f
LEFT JOIN users u ON f.userId = u.id
ORDER BY f.createdAt DESC
LIMIT 20;
